g.text: Pairwise McNemar tests, 1,000 eval queries: queries correct only with the row run : only with the column run

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Blue: row run significantly better; red: column run better (p < 0.05); grey: no significant difference. Color depth = share of the disagreements won.
